name: All-New, All-Different Avengers
description: After Secret Wars the Avengers branch into a crowded line of teams, with Kamala Khan, Nova, the Vision and Squirrel Girl among them. Rage of Ultron opens the journey, then Mark Waid's All-New, All-Different Avengers and Al Ewing's A.I.M. New Avengers run beside Uncanny Avengers and A-Force, through Standoff and Civil War II into Secret Empire. Great Lakes Avengers, Occupy Avengers and U.S.Avengers also appear.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
